# Washington Student Debt Navigation

> A Washington public-interest project about student retention, consumer debt litigation, garnishment, and the handoff between campus student-support systems and qualified legal help. This site provides general information, not legal advice.

Author: Jesse Zesbaugh, former AmeriCorps Benefits Hub Coach.
Last reviewed: October 7, 2026.

## Primary pages
- https://wastudentdebt.org/ — Project overview and thesis
- https://wastudentdebt.org/how-it-happens.html — Hypothetical student pathways and Washington's 2027 default-notice change
- https://wastudentdebt.org/get-help.html — Direct help resources for Washington students facing debt collection or garnishment
- https://wastudentdebt.org/for-navigators.html — Guidance for Benefits Hub coaches, Basic Needs Navigators, and student-support staff
- https://wastudentdebt.org/for-decision-makers.html — Systems questions and feasible handoff gaps for policymakers and institutions
- https://wastudentdebt.org/about.html — Author background and documented case chronology
- https://wastudentdebt.org/glossary-sources.html — Definitions, methodology, AI disclosure, and primary sources

## Reading guidance
- Sam, Maya, and Priya are hypothetical and are used to illustrate legally possible pathways.
- Jesse's personal case is identified separately and is based on his records.
- Legal, institutional, and statistical claims should be read with the cited primary or authoritative sources on the Sources page.
- The project does not advocate debt forgiveness, claim that all students face the same outcome, or provide legal advice.

## AI transparency
AI tools assisted with research organization, drafting, editing, and some illustrations. AI output is not treated as a factual source. Human review determines what is published.
